narr: A wet summer continued as several rounds of slow moving showers and thunderstorms led to heavy rain and flooding.
ev: Heavy rain caused numerous roads to be flooded in the Foley community with at least a foot of water reported on one of the roads.
Heavy rain caused several roads to be flooded in the Gulf Shores area.

Heavy rain caused water to cover the road along the Foley Beach Express at Doc McDuffie Road. In addition, the nearby river gauge for Wolf Creek rose almost 9 feet in just a couple hours time, resulting in flooding of other roads as well.
